title: Conformal uncertainty intervals for neural MOSFET models under shift: code, check logs and frozen results
description: Code (pipeline v10), PASS/FAIL check logs, figure data, figures and frozen results for the paper 'Conformal uncertainty intervals for neural MOSFET models under geometry, temperature, process-corner, and technology shift' by J. M. Omar and M. Tan. The study uses the MOSFET Electrical Simulation Dataset (MESD, commit 5dcc2236ac5b5eeb6228503f544053c2a359b636), which is not redistributed.

creators.name: Omar, Johaimen M.
